|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-lukeskywalker_ai.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-lukeskywalker_ai-2026-01-20-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-lukeskywalker_ai-2024-02-25.png]], 25 February 2024) → [[File:V0-L-lukeskywalker_ai-2026-01-20-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-lukeskywalker_ai.gif]], 20 January 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (ALT)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/lukeskywalker_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/711a663e087371089644de3bb8a6957e032582c0 commit 711a663] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113152717/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/711a663e087371089644de3bb8a6957e032582c0 Internet Archive])); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 11 December 2022<ref name="img-lukeskywalker_ai23a3730">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/lukeskywalker_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/23a3730ee5dc43921699d347d0a1ea05f8f2848a commit 23a3730] (11 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/lukeskywalker_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
